> @copilot 仔细审查，要完成任务中列出的所有开发

All issue tasks completed in commits 4f072c8–636fcd6:

**Task 1 — ObjectGrid rowHeight**: Extended from 3 to all 5 spec values (compact/short/medium/tall/extra_tall) — state type, cellClassName, cycleRowHeight, icon mapping. Zod schema already had 5 values ✅.

**Task 2 — Section field Spec coverage**: Verified all Appearance/UserActions/Sharing/Accessibility fields have UI controls, defaults, ordering, and conditional visibility. Added 19 ViewConfigPanel interaction tests covering toggle behaviors, conditional rendering (sharing visibility, navigation width/openNewTab), all 5 rowHeight clicks, boundary values (empty actions, long labels, special chars, invalid pageSizeOptions).

**Task 3 — Test coverage**: Added 41 total new tests: 14 ObjectGrid rowHeight, 19 ViewConfigPanel interactions, 8 schema spec alignment (accessibility ordering, emptyState, switch defaults, visibleWhen predicates). Full suite: 213 console tests, 186 plugin-grid tests, all passing.

**Task 5 — ROADMAP**: Updated with Phase 5 spec alignment completion section.
